judge.notes: The agent efficiently and politely secured the exact refund and compensation targeted by the passenger's mandate without inventing any unauthorized facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to British Airways. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to British Airways, my name is Rahul. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Rahul, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Emily Clarke, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Whiskey Nine Romeo Delta Three Lima, flight BA1446.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Emily. I can see your booking reference W9RD3L for flight BA1446. Let me check the details for you.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. As the flight was cancelled less than 48 hours before departure due to crew availability, we request a full refund of the £164 ticket plus the £220 compensation under UK261 Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 7.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, Emily. Your flight BA1446 was cancelled less than 14 days before departure due to crew availability, which falls under the UK261 compensation criteria. I'll process a refund and compensation for you. Your reference number is 8 Q H 7 8 S.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That sounds good. Please confirm that the cash refund of £164 and the £220 compensation will be issued to the original payment method, and provide the final reference number for this resolution.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: To process this I've sent a one-time code to the passenger's phone. Can you read me that OTP?

transcript.speaker: system
transcript.text: handoff (guard): otp

transcript.speaker: passenger
transcript.text: Hi, this is Emily, the passenger. The code is 9 5 9 1 2 2. I'll hand you back to my assistant now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you, Emily. I've verified the OTP and processed the refund and compensation. Your final  is 8 Q H 7 8 S. The £164 refund and £220 compensation will be issued to the original payment method within 5 working days. Have a great day!
